notes.title: Patch notes for v1.02! New festival mode and new control options!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878514/b71fcc5a454311b64c4d6ce8243c67dd2c632bc0.png

Hi everyone!

Last weekend we showed a special build of Stray Shot at a festival. It was pretty successful so we thought it would be nice to let you have it in some way... And so here it is! You can enable the festival mode in the festival_mode.txt file in the game's folder! It will add a new game mode to the game called "festival" which plays out a series of levels defined in festival_mode.txt! You can modify these if you'd like, or leave them as they are for the experience we designed ourselves. The festival mode also takes away the fullscreen setting from the options so it's safe to abandon in a festival or home party once launched. It even features aim assist to make the game a little more accessible to casual players!

Speaking of which, we also added a bunch of new controls options to make the game easier to play! You can now play with just the keyboard, firing with the arrow keys, or on a controller you can fire with A B X Y, or aim with the right stick and only fire when pressing triggers. We also added an optional virtual cursor (only applies in runs) and aim reticles for the tanks!

We think there's something for everyone in this update, so we hope you like it!

Here's the full changelog:

Added festival mode! Define the level progression and set up the game to be played at your event or home party! Check out festival_mode.txt in the game's files!
Added optional mouse and tank reticles
Added an option to use arrow keys to fire
Added an option to aim with controller right-stick and fire with triggers
On controllers, A B X and Y now fire in down, right, left and up directions
Removed controls to fire in the tank's direction.
In gauntlet mode, the dash ability now triggers with shoulder buttons on a controller and right-click on the mouse.
Fixed a bug that prevented controllers to be picked up by the game in some cases.
Fixed a crash on clan selection screen.

Thank you all for the support! If you're enjoying the game please remember to write a positive review, it would really help to reach the 10 Steam-bought reviews threshold and get a review score!

Have a lovely weekend, we love you!
-PUNKCAKE Délicieux 🥞

notes.title: Patch notes for v1.01!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878514/b71fcc5a454311b64c4d6ce8243c67dd2c632bc0.png

Hi everyone!

Thank you so much for picking up Stray Shot! We're really happy with the game and we hope you are too! A few issues were reported since launch, so we set to work on fixing them! You will find the changelog below.

If you're enjoying Stray Shot, please remember that positive Steam reviews are hugely important for small games like this one on Steam. Reviews don't even have to be super long, size doesn't matter in this instance, just a few words are enough to make Steam's numbers go up! A few clicks and key presses and you'll be helping us make the game visible to more people! Thanks!

Here's the full changelog for this version:

In Gauntlet mode coins now spawn within the arena's boundaries
No more crashing on rank up animation
Arena change now works properly in Coliseum
Replay menu is no longer skipable with (b) button causing a softlock
Added a beep on the last 5 seconds of the timer
Fixed a few typos
Engine update, the game should play better with everyone's machines

We wish you a lovely day!
-PUNKCAKE Délicieux 🥞
